div.div: The first plan's release shape put Phase 1 and Phase 2 in 6.0.0 and identity in 6.1. What shipped as 6.0.0 was identity (V6-01, V6-21, V6-30), done larger than recommended, with Phases 1 and 2 untouched: the Critical (V6-07) and ten Highs shipped unchanged under the major version. 6.1.0 should be Phase 1 and Phase 2, which now also carry TLS for the retail database (V6-52, V6-53) and the secure default in the code (V6-54); the acceptance tier (V6-67) should be in place before it is published.
